Mod.Name: 物品管理器 / Nico' Item Manager
Mod.Author: NicoKobo
Mod.Description: 浏览筛选物品、查看用途，并编辑模组、液体、电池、耐久、护甲、武器、使用次数、食物与标签。专用配置和已有数值直接显示，支持浮点数值。常见标签按物品或类型匹配中英文名称与说明，悬停可查看原始键。支持实时预览、独立生成按钮、导出和界面缩放。 Home 开关面板，Esc 返回或关闭。选择物品查看或编辑，再点击 Spawn 生成。右键背包或自己桌面的自有物品并选择「物品管理」，也可悬停后按 End。两项快捷键均可在 Mod 设置中修改。 Browse and filter items, inspect uses, and edit modules, liquids, batteries, durability, armor, weapons, uses, food and tags. Specialized settings and existing numeric values are shown directly, including floating-point values. Common tags have Chinese and English names and descriptions matched by item or type, with original keys in tooltips. Includes live previews, a separate spawn button, export and UI scaling. Home toggles the panel. Esc goes back or closes it. Select an item to inspect or edit it, then use Spawn to create it. Right-click an owned item in your backpack or on your desktop and choose Manage item, or hover over it and press End. Both shortcuts can be changed in mod settings.
